title: Retrospective analysis of pain relief through acupuncture treatments for inpatient multimodal pain therapy (MMPT)
summary: Multimodal Pain Management (MMST) is recognized as a gold pain therapy of conventional medicine. Acupuncture is a pain relieving treatment of traditional Chinese medicine for chronic pain. We will evaluate whether the combination of acupuncture with MMST can provide even better pain relief in inpatients with chronic pain.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The included period: beginning of 2011 - end of 2015.

The included patients: patients with chronic pain
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete data,
Treatment of MMST and / or TCM primarily rejecting patients,
Incomplete data 
Implementation of MMST.
